provenance.note: The exact script text of the validate_bidding_and_state code node on each RML bidding workflow. Extracted verbatim from workflow_versions.definition on 2026-08-21 and then repaired for #926. Held as strings rather than .js files because apps/worker typechecks against @cloudflare/workers-types with no node types, so a test cannot read a sibling file from disk; a JSON import is how the archive fixtures are loaded too.
provenance.readIt: To read one as code: node -e "console.log(require(`./rml-validate-scripts.json`).scripts.lendswift.script)"
provenance.copyWarning: This is a copy of something whose source of truth is the database, and nothing in CI can reach the database, so nothing here detects it going stale. A passing suite is not evidence that production matches this file. Whoever edits either node in the canvas edits this file in the same change. #934 is the consolidation that removes the copy.
